negative_findings.description: Direct HTTP fetch of https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/PublicAccess/home.aspx returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: No page content retrieved. The portal is indexed by search engines and referenced by numerous live government pages, so this is almost certainly a WAF/bot-defence response rather than a dead endpoint. Recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The primary source of this cell cannot be collected with a plain HTTP fetcher; the collection pipeline must budget for a headless browser with realistic headers, or use the data.gov.mk bulk publication instead.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language searches combining e-nabavki with payments-specific terms ("POS терминали", "банкарски софтвер", "избор на најповолен понудувач") returned no individual banking/payments award notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search engines surfaced only the portal shell, unrelated tender PDFs (customs, water utility, EVN) and practitioner manuals. No named vendor award for core banking, card systems, POS or ATM supply was located from outside the portal.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Award-level content on the ESJN is behind a JS grid and is effectively not search-indexed. Vendor evidence for this cell must be obtained by querying the portal itself, not by web search — this changes the collection design fundamentally.

negative_findings.description: No official, documented public API or OpenAPI specification for the ESJN was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only an undocumented ASMX endpoint (Infrastructure.asmx/LoadLanguage) leaked into search results, plus a community scraper documenting a dossier page URL with Id/Level parameters. Bureau/Ministry pages describe modules but not programmatic access.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Machine access is possible but unofficial and fragile; the pipeline needs a monitored, versioned scraper plus a fallback to data.gov.mk bulk files.

negative_findings.description: The data.gov.mk publication of the ESJN 'concluded contracts' module was described by secondary sources but its actual file URL, schema, field coverage and update cadence were not confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Portal is confirmed to exist and to carry a redirecting link to the download location; the download itself was not opened.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If this dataset is complete and current it removes most scraping cost for A6; if it is stale or omits the awarded-operator field it is nearly useless. This is the single highest-leverage thing to verify next.

negative_findings.description: No mapping was established between the CPV/subject codes used in the ESJN and banking/payments IT categories (core banking, card management, POS/ATM hardware, payment switch, HSM, personalisation).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches did not surface a Macedonian CPV list applied to financial-sector IT procurement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a CPV/keyword filter set the collector must either fetch everything or risk missing awards; building this mapping is a prerequisite for efficient, recall-safe collection.

negative_findings.description: No specific TED contract award notice for a North Macedonia banking or payment-system contract was retrievable through general web search; results returned only TED platform-level and coverage documentation.
negative_findings.result_summary: TED's MK coverage is documented (TED covers the EEA, Switzerland and the Republic of North Macedonia), but individual MK banking/payments award notices did not surface via search engines — they are behind TED's own faceted search/API rather than in the general web index.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell must go through TED's native search/API with CPV and country facets; a search-engine-based approach will systematically miss the actual award records.

negative_findings.description: EBRD project procurement notices are no longer published on ebrd.com listings.
negative_findings.result_summary: EBRD guidance confirms procurement, prequalification, shortlisting and contract award notices for EBRD loan/grant-financed contracts are now published ONLY on ECEPP (ecepp.ebrd.com). Historic ebrd.com notice URLs will therefore under-report.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any legacy collection pointed at ebrd.com procurement notice pages will silently return incomplete results; the collector must target ECEPP.

negative_findings.description: No Macedonian-language index of EU/IFI tender notices specific to financial infrastructure was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Macedonian-language searches for ЕБОР/Светска банка + набавка consistently redirected to the national portals (e-nabavki.gov.mk, finance.gov.mk, cfcd.finance.gov.mk) or to institutional description pages, not to a Macedonian-language donor-tender index. Donor procurement in MK is effectively English-first, with only the CFCD/IPA layer and e-Nabavki republication in Macedonian.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's premise: cross-border and donor-financed contracts are English-first. Local-language monitoring adds value mainly at the CFCD/IPA and commercial-bank/press layers, not at the tender-index layer.

negative_findings.description: Several key channels are gated.
negative_findings.result_summary: STEP requires participant login; UN Development Business and DevelopmentAid require paid subscriptions for full notice text; ECEPP requires free registration for bidding (though notice pages appear publicly viewable).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget and access planning are needed; free public derivatives (WB Finances One dataset, WB procurement-plan documents, EU portal) should carry the bulk of the collection load.

negative_findings.description: The Development Bank of North Macedonia domain was inferred rather than confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: MBDP/DBNM is repeatedly named in EIB records as the intermediary, but no authoritative link to its own website was observed in results; mbdp.com.mk is an inference and must be confirmed before use.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recording an unconfirmed domain risks a dead or wrong source in the registry; flagged here rather than asserted as verified.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated KfW procurement channel for North Macedonia financial-sector contracts was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: KfW appears in MK only in co-financing contexts found in this run (a joint EBRD-KfW 134MWdc solar financing), not in financial-infrastructure procurement. KfW/DEG financial-sector engagement in MK may exist but was not evidenced by these searches.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: KfW should be treated as a low-priority, on-demand channel for this cell until evidence of financial-sector procurement in MK appears, rather than as a standing collection target.

negative_findings.description: Targeted mk-language searches combining MK job vocabulary with named payments platforms (ISO 8583, Base24, Way4, Temenos, FLEXCUBE) returned no live MK job ad that explicitly names those products.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced portals and generic card-system ads (e.g. 'Администратор на картичен систем') but no indexed ad body containing the product names. Most likely causes: MK ads describe duties in Macedonian generic terms rather than product names, and expired ads are deleted rather than archived, so search engines hold little of the corpus.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that this cell cannot rely on search engines — the signal must be captured continuously at publication time, not retrieved retrospectively. It also means product names will more often appear in English LinkedIn/vendor ads than in mk-language bank ads.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn job search, company job tabs and member profiles are login-gated and their ToS bars scraping.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only teaser listings and counts (e.g. 240 engineering jobs in Skopje, 454 total) were visible unauthenticated. The single FLEXCUBE-in-Macedonia CV evidence found in this pass came from a mirrored public resume on Toptal, not from LinkedIn itself.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The richest product-naming source in the cell is legally and technically constrained to manual review; budget analyst time or a licensed data product rather than assuming automated collection.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated careers/vacancies page located for KIBS AD Skopje, and none for several banks (Halkbank, Sparkasse, ProCredit, Silk Road, UNIBanka, TTK) in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned corporate and registry pages but no vacancy sections. Their ads did appear republished on bankarstvo.mk, which suggests the ads exist but the career pages are either unindexed, differently named, or the banks publish only via aggregators.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Per-bank career-page URLs must be resolved by direct site inspection before the monitor can claim per-institution coverage; until then bankarstvo.mk is a single point of failure for those institutions.

negative_findings.description: Two distinct things are named 'JobMatch' in North Macedonia.
negative_findings.result_summary: jobmatch.mk is a private IT job-ad tracker with skill statistics; 'Job Match' (mk.gov.jobmatch on Google Play) is the Employment Agency's platform connecting unemployed persons with employers. They must not be conflated when configuring collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Mistargeting would substitute a general labour-market app for the IT-skill-frequency analytics that actually serve this cell.

negative_findings.description: No stable Macedonian-language rendering was found for several vendor-product concepts central to this cell.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK ads use generic Macedonian ('картичен систем', 'основен банкарски систем' style phrasing, 'платежни системи') while product names (Temenos, FLEXCUBE, Base24, Way4, ISO 8583) appear only in Latin script when they appear at all. There is no Cyrillic transliteration convention in use for these product names in MK job ads.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection queries must be bilingual per-ad: match Cyrillic duty vocabulary to find the ad, then scan the ad body for Latin-script product tokens.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, MK-hosted banking/fintech conference brand (an MK equivalent of INFINTECH or Money Motion) was found in either mk or en searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK banking-sector event activity appears to ride on adjacent platforms instead: the NBRSM payments conference, the MSE annual conference, MASIT's ICT conference and specialised SEPA event, and the AETM regional e-commerce conference. Regional banking events are hosted in Montenegro, Croatia and Albania.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coverage of MK vendor-courting activity must be assembled from adjacent-sector and regional events plus vendor newsrooms; a single-source strategy would miss most of it.

negative_findings.description: For several confirmed MK events, the sponsor/partner roster page itself was not located in this run — only press restatements of sponsors.
negative_findings.result_summary: E.g. sponsors of the AETM regional e-commerce conference (Kasys, Payton, Mastercard, A1, Komercijalna banka) were found via bankarstvo.mk articles, not via a scraped sponsor page; MASIT's annual conference sponsor tiers beyond Halkbank as 'Patron Partner' were not enumerated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sponsor-tier detail (gold/silver/bronze) is the strongest spend signal; relying on press restatements loses the tier and risks omission.

negative_findings.description: Searching for named North Macedonian bank speakers at regional events (Money Motion, INFINTECH, Balkan Payment Forum) returned no confirmed MK-affiliated speaker in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sponsor lists at Money Motion 2026 include NLB at group level (relevant to NLB Banka Skopje) but no MK-domiciled speaker was evidenced. Speaker pages were not individually fetched and filtered.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MK participation in regional events is the core of this cell's rationale; absence of evidence here is a collection gap, not evidence of absence.

negative_findings.description: No established Macedonian-language term or awards programme was found for 'fintech awards' / 'payments innovation award' as a domestic category.
negative_findings.result_summary: Domestic award coverage in mk clusters on 'банка на годината' (an international magazine award restated locally) and 'E-commerce Awards' (merchant-facing). No native MK fintech/payments innovation award surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If a domestic awards programme exists under an English-only name, our mk glossary would miss it; conversely its absence means award signals must come from international programmes.

negative_findings.description: No publicly indexed UJP page listing approved/authorised fiscal-device suppliers or certified fiscal-system types was surfaced by mk-language searching, despite the regulation index at ujp.gov.mk/mk/regulativa/pregled/tipovi/fis existing.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned enforcement news and general fiscalisation obligations but no vendor/type-approval register URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The approved-supplier register is the single highest-value competitor list for the fiscalisation segment; it may exist as a PDF or an internal page requiring a targeted crawl of ujp.gov.mk rather than search-engine discovery.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Ministry of Finance 'digital payments strategy' document was found; digital-payment commitments appear embedded in the Fiscal Strategy (2027-2031), MoF strategic plans and the MDT ICT/SMART-MK strategies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search for a MoF digital-payments strategy returned the ministry homepage, archived strategic-planning pages and news about the Fiscal Strategy instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must target multiple partial documents rather than one roadmap; missing this leads to an incomplete picture of the payments agenda.

negative_findings.description: The UJP national e-Faktura platform is described in multiple mk sources (pilot from January, mandatory October 2026) but no official government URL for the platform itself was surfaced in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only vendor/advisory explainer pages describing the platform were found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The official platform, its technical specification and any registry of accredited e-invoicing providers would be the authoritative vendor-selection source; it must be located by direct crawling of ujp.gov.mk and ENER.

negative_findings.description: The Official Gazette site (slvesnik.com.mk) was not fetched in this pass; its access model (free issue index vs paid archive) is assumed, not confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Gazette texts were reached only through third-party mirrors (mchamber.mk, proagens.mk, nbrm.mk).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the primary gazette is paywalled or bot-defended, the collection design must rely on institutional mirrors; this should be settled by the deterministic liveness pass, not assumed here.

negative_findings.description: The e-nabavki public-access interface is an ASP.NET single-page application with postback-driven search, so tender data is not reachable by simple URL enumeration.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the Home.aspx entry point is directly addressable from search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget for a headless-browser or session-aware collector; a naive HTTP crawler will return an empty shell and could be misread as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Macedonian and English for a КЗК (competition commission) decision specifically about payment cards, interchange or card acquiring in North Macedonia.
negative_findings.result_summary: No such decision surfaced in search results. Only generic КЗК contact/legal-framework pages and unrelated sectors (retail chains, chamber of commerce) appeared. The КЗК decision registers exist but their contents were not indexed by the search engine at case level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cannot yet confirm whether North Macedonia has any public competition case touching card/payment markets. The registers must be crawled directly rather than relied on via search.

negative_findings.description: Looked for an NBRSM page listing supervisory measures, fines or misdemeanour proceedings imposed on individual banks/payment institutions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Found the supervision hub and the 'Одлуки од областа на супервизијата' regulatory page, but no evidence of a per-institution enforcement/sanctions register. NBRSM appears to publish the rules and licence-related decisions rather than a named sanctions list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If no named-sanctions register exists, enforcement intelligence on PSPs must be reconstructed from Службен весник, annual supervision reports, court records and press — a much higher-cost collection path.

negative_findings.description: Attempted direct fetch of the ДЗР audit reports listing page.
negative_findings.result_summary: HTTP 403 Forbidden from dzr.mk while the same site appears healthy in search results and its PDF files are widely linked. Recorded as bot-defended/unverified, NOT as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection of the highest-value source in this cell will need a browser-like fetcher or an alternate route (Google cache, direct PDF paths under /sites/default/files/).

negative_findings.description: The English-language КЗК decisions URL surfaced by search (kzk.gov.mk/en/category/decisions-acts/competition-decisions-acts/decisions-in-administrative-procedure/) returned HTTP 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: The English mirror path appears stale/moved; the live navigation uses Cyrillic-path Macedonian URLs under /одлуки/конкуренција/. Treat the English tree as unreliable rather than absent.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An en-only collection configuration would silently miss the entire competition decision corpus — confirming that mk-language paths are mandatory here.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Macedonian for a National Bank consumer-complaints channel for bank/PSP users comparable to the Serbian NBS 'приговор' system.
negative_findings.result_summary: Macedonian-language results were dominated by the Serbian (NBS) and Bulgarian (BNB) equivalents; no distinct NBRSM public complaints register or statistics page was identified. Only the consumer NGO (ОПМ) financial-services desk was found on the MK side.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Consumer-complaint volumes by institution — a good proxy for service/technology failures at named banks and PSPs — may not be publicly published in MK, leaving a real intelligence gap in this cell.

negative_findings.description: The State Commission for Public Procurement Appeals appears under three hosts: dkzjn.gov.mk, dkzjn.mk and dkzjn.sorsix.com.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not determine from search alone which host is canonical and which holds the searchable decisions database; the sorsix.com host suggests a vendor-hosted case system.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Picking the wrong host risks collecting a stale mirror; also, the sorsix-hosted instance is itself a vendor signal worth noting separately.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Macedonian and English for a domestic BNPL provider (buy-now-pay-later as a standalone non-bank product).
negative_findings.result_summary: All 'на рати' results were bank-issued interest-free card installment programmes (Stopanska, Komercijalna, NLB) or merchant pages relying on them; no independent MK BNPL fintech surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests installments in MK remain a card-issuer product, so BNPL competitive risk to banks is currently internal rather than from a non-bank challenger — but this needs a second pass with different terms before being asserted.

negative_findings.description: Looked for a licensed crypto-asset exchange or VASP register for North Macedonia.
negative_findings.result_summary: Found only NBRNM crypto Q&A, Ministry of Finance statements that crypto 'will be regulated by law', and FIU material on virtual assets; no register of licensed crypto/e-money crypto firms was located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Crypto/e-money startups in the cell may be unlicensed or foreign-domiciled, so they will not appear in any MK register and must be tracked via media, app stores and company registry instead.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to locate a corporate/official web presence for 'МКПеј / MKPEJ', reported as preparing the first Macedonian e-wallet.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only secondary press mentions were found; no company site, license entry, or app listing surfaced in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A potentially significant domestic wallet challenger is currently only traceable via press; needs targeted follow-up in the Central Registry and the NBRNM e-money register.

negative_findings.description: No page in this slice was fetched; all URLs come from search result listings.
negative_findings.result_summary: Every URL is recorded as unverified pending the deterministic liveness pass; nbrm.mk .nspx pages in particular are known to be session/JS-sensitive and may need a browser-based fetch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents false confidence about reachability and warns the collector that regulator register pages may need non-trivial fetching.

negative_findings.description: Direct programmatic access to the Wayback Machine (CDX API and snapshot fetch) was refused by this agent's fetch tool with the message that it cannot fetch from web.archive.org.
negative_findings.result_summary: No archived MK bank or vendor snapshot could be enumerated or read during this run; the archive route remains a hypothesis to be executed by a collector outside this harness.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The archive lane is the highest-value part of this cell (deleted vendor reference lists, pre-merger bank pages). Its evidence is unrealised until a non-restricted HTTP client runs the CDX queries.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'Emerging Europe' (emerging-europe.com) article or intelligence country profile specific to North Macedonia banking/fintech surfaced in search, despite it being named in the cell definition.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned Fintech Times, Mondaq and bne IntelliNews instead; emerging-europe.com did not appear in results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell assumed Emerging Europe as a pillar aggregator; if its MK banking coverage is thin or not indexed, budget should shift to SeeNews, bne IntelliNews and IFI reports.

negative_findings.description: ECB payments statistics do not cover North Macedonia (a non-EU, non-euro-area country); only EU and partially reporting non-euro-area EU Member States are in scope.
negative_findings.result_summary: The ECB Data Portal is therefore a benchmarking source, not an MK data source; MK card/POS/terminal series must come from NBRM.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a false expectation that MK payment volumes are obtainable from ECB datasets, and redirects the collection plan to NBRM statistics (covered by other cells).

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language searching for regional/aggregator market analysis (Македонија банки платежни системи регионален извештај СЕЕ анализа пазар) returned almost exclusively NBRM's own pages, not regional aggregator or analyst content.
negative_findings.result_summary: Regional aggregators appear to publish about MK almost entirely in English; MK-language regional analyst material was not found in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that for this cell the language of record is English, while MK-language terms remain necessary for the archive lane (searching archived MK bank pages) rather than for finding aggregators.

negative_findings.description: No public vendor case study was found describing a named Printec implementation at a North Macedonian bank.
negative_findings.result_summary: Vendor case-study search surfaced Asseco SEE's Komercijalna Banka ATM delivery and generic Diebold Nixdorf material, but nothing MK-specific from Printec.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A gap in the competitor/own-footprint evidence base; archived versions of printec.com country/reference pages are the most likely recovery route.

negative_findings.description: Every nbrm.mk URL attempted returned HTTP 403 Forbidden — via WebFetch and via curl with a realistic desktop Chrome User-Agent and mk/en Accept-Language, for .nspx pages and for static PDFs under /WBStorage/Files/ and /content/ alike.
negative_findings.result_summary: 0 of 4 direct fetch attempts succeeded (registers hub, MIPS/KIBS page, payment-systems PDF, e-money register). All pages are indexed with current titles in search, so they are live; this is a WAF/bot rule, not link rot. Treated as unverified-but-live, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The entire cell's primary evidence sits behind this defence. Any collection pipeline for MK regulator data must use a real browser engine (Playwright/headless Chrome with full header set, possibly a residential/EU egress IP) rather than HTTP clients, or fall back to FOI requests.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, separately titled 'payment systems oversight report' (надзор над платните системи) series was located as its own publication in this pass; the closest identified is the recurring 'Годишна информација за движењата во плаќањата' and payment-systems statistical PDFs, plus oversight chapters likely inside the Annual Report and Financial Stability Report.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in mk for oversight-report phrasing returned statistical PDFs and the annual payments-developments presentation (2017 edition URL confirmed) rather than a standalone oversight-report series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The oversight narrative — which systems are designated, how they are assessed against PFMI — may only be reachable inside larger annual publications, so the collector must parse chapters rather than expect a clean report series.

negative_findings.description: No exemption/negative register ('Регистар на субјекти кои даваат услуги врз основа на платежни инструменти на кои не се применуваат одредбите од законот') URL was pinned down, although an English search snippet quotes NBRSM describing exactly such a register.
negative_findings.result_summary: The register is referenced in NBRSM English text captured by search, but its own page URL was not isolated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: That register lists limited-network / commercial-agent schemes — closed-loop fuel, transit and retail card operators that are real competitors to general-purpose payments but invisible in the main PI/EMI registers.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language queries repeatedly surfaced Bulgarian National Bank (bnb.bg) pages, because Bulgarian and Macedonian share Cyrillic banking terminology ('регистър/регистар', 'платежни институции', 'платежни услуги').
negative_findings.result_summary: Roughly half the hits on two mk queries were bnb.bg, not nbrm.mk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated MK collection must domain-pin to nbrm.mk (and .mk generally) or it will silently ingest Bulgarian regulator data as Macedonian. Flag 'регистър' (Bulgarian spelling) as a noisy term distinct from 'регистар' (Macedonian).

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) NBRSM payments register or oversight page was found, despite Albanian being an official language in RNM.
negative_findings.result_summary: NBRSM appears to publish payments material in mk and en only; run scope did not include sq, and no sq terms were used.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If Albanian-language coverage is ever needed for the wider MK market, it will have to come from non-regulator sources, not NBRSM.

negative_findings.description: No commercial bank in this cell was found to publish a public procurement / tender / 'јавни набавки' page. Navigation extraction of kb.mk showed no procurement section, and no MK-language search surfaced a bank RFP portal.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero public bank RFP/nabavki pages found across the ten banks in scope.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: MK systemic banks are private and outside the Bureau for Public Procurement regime, so procurement intent is invisible ex ante. Vendor selection can only be reconstructed ex post from press releases, annual reports, app metadata and vendor case studies.

negative_findings.description: https://www.unibank.com.mk/ returned no output on a single WebFetch attempt.
negative_findings.result_summary: One failed fetch; not retried with an alternative client.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: UNIBanka is in the cell scope; the failure is most likely bot defence or a timeout rather than a dead site, so it must be re-attempted with a browser-based fetcher before any conclusion is drawn.

negative_findings.description: The sparkasse.mk homepage fetch exposed no news/press-release link; only a Финансиски извештаи page was located, and that via a site-scoped search rather than on-site navigation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sparkasse MK press-release index not located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An Erste-group bank almost certainly issues press releases; if there is genuinely no on-site archive, coverage of Sparkasse must lean on bankarstvo.mk, LinkedIn and the Erste Group report, which weakens primary-source confidence.

negative_findings.description: Two assumed domains were wrong: ProCredit Bank MK is at pcb.mk (not procreditbank.com.mk) and UNIBanka at unibank.com.mk (not uni.com.mk); kb.com.mk 302-redirects to kb.mk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three domain corrections established before any crawling was configured.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a downstream collector from recording live banks as dead sources on bad seed URLs.

negative_findings.description: Across the Komercijalna, Stopanska, NLB and Halkbank digital-launch announcements surfaced in this pass, no supplier/system vendor was named in the bank's own text (the sole partner named anywhere was KIBS, the domestic digital-certificate issuer, in a Stopanska banka item).
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank press releases describe capability, not supplier.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Establishes that the direct sources alone cannot answer 'who supplied this' — vendor-side collateral and technical fingerprints (app package ids, API portals, job ads) are structurally necessary, not optional supplements.

negative_findings.description: Halkbank MK, ProCredit (pcb.mk) and UNIBanka news/annual-report index paths were not individually confirmed by fetch within this pass; only their root domains and product pages were established.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three of ten banks have unconfirmed newsroom/report paths.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are hypotheses for the next pass, not verified sources; recording them as confirmed would overstate coverage.

negative_findings.description: Neither kibs.mk nor casys.com.mk publishes an explicit, machine-readable list of member banks / processing clients. KIBS pages describe services and counterparty categories (banks, treasury, HIF, Central Register, UJP) but name no institutions; CaSys names card schemes but no bank clients.
negative_findings.result_summary: Participant enumeration must be reconstructed from NBRNM system-description pages, MIPS participant counts (~20) and press coverage rather than from operator sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Who-supplies-whom in switching/issuing must be inferred indirectly, raising evidence cost and lowering certainty for partnership mapping.

negative_findings.description: nbrm.mk (National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to an automated fetch of https://www.nbrm.mk/mipsdd77afa6.nspx. Search engines index the site normally, so this is bot defence, not a dead site.
negative_findings.result_summary: All nbrm.mk candidates are recorded as blocked=true / unverified rather than dead; collection should use a real browser session.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The regulator holds the authoritative operator register, MIPS/KIBS/CaSys system descriptions and payment statistics — the single most valuable node in this cell.

negative_findings.description: Searches in mk and en for a distinct national card scheme (equivalent to Bancomat/BankAxept) found none. The nearest construct is CaSys / International Card System AD operating multilateral deferred net settlement for domestic-brand cards, alongside international schemes (Visa, Mastercard, Diners).
negative_findings.result_summary: No separate domestic scheme brand or scheme-rulebook publisher identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Removes a whole expected source category; scheme-level intelligence must come from CaSys and NBRNM instead.

negative_findings.description: Local-language searches combining Asseco SEE / Payten / Printec with Македонија, банкомати, ПОС and банка договор returned no MK-specific contract, reference or case-study page from these vendors.
negative_findings.result_summary: Vendor-side confirmation of MK ATM/POS estate suppliers not found in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Supplier mapping for the terminal and switch layer remains unevidenced; needs tender/procurement and bank annual-report routes.

negative_findings.description: No consolidated public source was found listing MK ATM/POS acquirers and their merchant-acquiring volumes per bank; NBRNM payment statistics appear to aggregate device and transaction counts nationally rather than by acquirer.
negative_findings.result_summary: Acquirer-level market shares are not directly published.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Competitive sizing of the acquiring layer will require bank-by-bank annual reports, a separate workstream from this cell.

negative_findings.description: No Temenos, Oracle FLEXCUBE or Finastra page naming a North Macedonian bank as a published customer was found in this pass. The only evidence linking Temenos T24 and Oracle Mantas to Stopanska Banka came from a third-party technographics aggregator, not from the vendors themselves.
negative_findings.result_summary: Vendor-side confirmation of MK core-banking installs is absent from open search results; only aggregator claims exist.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Core-banking vendor identity is the single highest-value competitor fact for this market; relying on an unverified aggregator risks propagating a wrong vendor-bank pairing.

negative_findings.description: Neither Diebold Nixdorf nor NCR Atleos surfaced any press release or case study naming a North Macedonian bank; the only MK ATM-vendor evidence found was second-hand, via Printec's local country page describing NCR SelfServ deployment at HALKBANK AD Skopje.
negative_findings.result_summary: OEM newsrooms appear silent on MK; the channel partner (Printec) is the disclosing party.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that in MK the ATM/self-service supply chain is visible mainly at the integrator/distributor layer, so collection must be aimed at channel partners rather than OEM newsrooms.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language queries using generic vendor-marketing vocabulary ('студија на случај', 'успешна приказна', 'имплементација решение банка') returned academic methodology pages, government fintech-strategy documents and non-banking ERP success stories rather than vendor case studies naming banks.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK-language vendor case-study genre appears thin to non-existent; local vendors publish wins as news items and LinkedIn posts, not as case studies.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language collection strategy must be re-tuned toward 'соопштение', 'партнерство', 'нова услуга', 'во соработка со', and bank brand names instead of case-study vocabulary.

negative_findings.description: No Mastercard or Visa press release naming a North Macedonian bank partnership or MK tokenization/wallet launch was found; scheme newsrooms returned only global and Western-European announcements.
negative_findings.result_summary: Scheme-level MK announcements not visible in indexed English press for the searched period.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Scheme press is normally a reliable pointer to issuer-side technology partners; its absence means MK scheme news likely appears only in local media or bank press rooms.

negative_findings.description: Root/landing URLs for casys.com.mk, duna.mk, and the newsroom/case-study index paths for Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos, Temenos and Oracle were inferred from company identity and standard site structure rather than clicked through in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Several candidate URLs are pattern-inferred and must be liveness-checked by the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents false confidence: these are plausible entry points, not confirmed-reachable pages.

negative_findings.description: Neither Semos (semos.com.mk) nor Duna (duna.mk) nor Edusoft (edusoft.com.mk) exposes a discoverable banking-specific 'references' or 'clients' page in search results. Semos surfaced mainly through careers pages and its Semos Education arm; Duna through retail/fiscal and public-sector projects; Edusoft through vertical marketing pages that claim finance/insurance expertise without naming customers.
negative_findings.result_summary: mk-language queries combining each company name with банкарски софтвер / референци / банка returned company profiles, job ads and directory entries — no named bank end-customers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For these three seed actors the indirect route (bank-side press, app metadata, tender awards, LinkedIn project mentions) will have to substitute for vendor reference lists; do not conclude they have no bank business.

negative_findings.description: The Netcetera global references index page lists ~9 visible case studies (Atruvia, Finnova, Stet, Valiant, Klar, Zak/Bank Cler, SIX, Viseca, PostFinance) and claims 2190 client projects, but shows no Southeast Europe / North Macedonia entries on the index itself.
negative_findings.result_summary: The MK-relevant Halkbank reference exists at a deep URL (/references/Halkbank.html) reachable only via search, not via the index page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deep-linked reference pages are invisible to index-only crawling; collection must enumerate the /references/ slug space or rely on search, or MK evidence will be systematically missed.

negative_findings.description: A Macedonian-language search for ATM/POS hardware distributors and service partners in MK (NCR, Diebold Nixdorf and similar) returned only bank ATM-locator pages and generic ATM maps, no named local distributor or maintenance partner.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries on банкомати / дистрибутер / сервис / партнер produced zero channel-company results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The self-service hardware channel is a core Printec-adjacent segment and is currently an evidence hole for MK; it needs a different attack (public procurement notices, bank tender awards, hardware-vendor partner locators, service-company registry codes).

negative_findings.description: Sorsix, IT Labs and Interworks — frequently cited MK software houses — could not be tied to banking or payments clients in this pass; searches returned generic company profiles, Glassdoor/SourceSeek entries and unrelated bank Wikipedia pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: No finance-vertical evidence found for these three actors.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: They should stay on the long-list as unconfirmed rather than be either promoted or discarded; a targeted mk-language pass per company is needed.

negative_findings.description: The current corporate domain for ASEE North Macedonia (post-rebrand from ASSECO SEE) was not confirmed; searches routed to directory entries (zk.mk), a news item about the rebrand, and DevelopmentAid rather than the company's own MK site. Same for Ultra's corporate domain.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two significant local channel actors are documented only through third-party profiles.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ASEE is likely the single largest banking-software supplier in the MK channel; leaving its primary site unresolved would leave the biggest competitor node uncovered.

negative_findings.description: https://www.semos.com.mk/ returned a 'Parse Error: Invalid header token' and https://masit.org.mk/en/members-en/ returned HTTP 404 (the real path is /en/members-of-masit/ per the site menu).
negative_findings.result_summary: Two fetch failures, both attributable to server header quirks / wrong path guesses rather than dead sites; individual MASIT member slugs under /members-mk/ and /en/members-en/ do resolve in search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These must be recorded as unverified, not dead; a retry with a browser user-agent and the correct listing path is required.

negative_findings.description: No free, machine-readable bulk export of the MK Trade Register or the Register of Annual Accounts was found. Searches in Macedonian for a CRM API / e-distribution service led only to the fee-based Дистрибутивен систем (https://www.crm.com.mk/DS/orders), with search snippets indicating an account plus a minimum prepayment of roughly MKD 5,000.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk registry data appears to be a paid, contract-based channel; no open API endpoint was identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any plan to screen the whole population of MK payments/IT vendors by activity code must be budgeted as a data purchase, or routed through a licensed aggregator such as CompanyWall.

negative_findings.description: The Register of Beneficial Owners is reported as accessible only through an official procedure and payment of a fee; open publication is still an OGP commitment (MK0144/MK0185) targeted initially at public-procurement winners rather than all companies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Beneficial ownership data exists and is legally compulsory, but is not openly searchable by the public today.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ownership-graph work on MK vendors and local partners of foreign vendors must be done case-by-case and cannot be automated at this time.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated register or published list of branches/representative offices of foreign companies in North Macedonia was found as a separate searchable dataset; branches appear to be filed inside the general Trade Register through a registration agent.
negative_findings.result_summary: Foreign-vendor branch entries must be discovered by name search within the general Trade Register, not from a standalone foreign-branch list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Detecting a foreign payments vendor's market entry requires an active name watchlist rather than passive monitoring of a branch registry feed.

negative_findings.description: A Macedonian-language query for the National Bank of RNM register of payment service providers / payment institutions returned almost exclusively Bulgarian National Bank pages, because of Cyrillic term overlap between mk and bg ('Народна банка', 'регистър/регистар', 'платежни').
negative_findings.result_summary: The NBRSM payment-institution register URL was not confirmed in this run; only a Службен весник PDF of the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems (2022) surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cross-lingual Cyrillic bleed is a systematic hazard for MK local-language searching; queries must be pinned with MK-specific tokens ('РСМ', 'Северна Македонија', site:nbrm.mk) to avoid BG contamination.

negative_findings.description: The fetched CRM service page for Основен профил did not expose a direct link to the public search application itself; the search entry point was only described, not linked, in the retrieved markdown.
negative_findings.result_summary: The exact URL of the free public entity-search app was not isolated; only the service description page was retrieved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection pipeline needs the concrete query endpoint; this is an open item for the verification pass, not evidence that the service is absent.

negative_findings.description: No formal, incorporated fintech association with a public member directory was found for North Macedonia. Searches in mk and en returned only informal community pages (Fintech MK on Medium/Facebook), the regional Balkan Fintech Association, and the alternative-lenders body AFD.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fintech representation in MK appears to sit inside MASIT, the Economic Chamber's non-bank financial group, and the e-commerce association rather than in a standalone fintech chamber.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any expectation of a single fintech member census for MK is unfounded; the fintech actor map must be assembled from MASIT + mchamber groups + ecommerce.mk.

negative_findings.description: MBA's website confirms the membership composition (all banks and savings houses, plus KIBS clearing house and the Macedonian Credit Bureau) but a clean per-institution member page was not located in this run; the count cited (14 banks, 2 savings houses) derives from a 2020-dated statement.
negative_findings.result_summary: Membership is stated narratively rather than as a maintained structured directory.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The bank census should be reconciled against the National Bank's licensed-institutions register rather than taken from MBA text alone; MBA figures may be stale.

negative_findings.description: Searched in mk and en for MASIT position papers on banking/digital transformation; only news-format advocacy items (e.g. on formalising the economy through digital solutions) were found, not a documents/publications library.
negative_findings.result_summary: Advocacy output appears distributed through the news feed rather than a dedicated policy-paper section.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must monitor the news feeds continuously; a one-off scrape of a 'publications' page will find nothing.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language association and chamber sources (notably the Chamber of Commerce of NW Macedonia / Oda Ekonomike e Maqedonisë Veriperëndimore) were not searched, because Albanian is outside the run's declared languages (mk, en).
negative_findings.result_summary: A material part of the MK business-association ecosystem publishes primarily in Albanian and was left uncovered.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor and member lists for the Albanian-language business community are likely under-represented in this slice.

negative_findings.description: Domains for the NW Macedonia chamber (oemvp.org) and the Union of Chambers (chamber.mk) were inferred from organisational identity and social-media handles rather than confirmed by a successful fetch in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded with low confidence and flagged as unverified rather than omitted or asserted as live.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream liveness verification must resolve these before they enter the tracked-source register.

negative_findings.description: Fakulteti.mk was named in the cell definition as a business/news portal, but MK/AL searches targeting its business desk returned no fakulteti.mk results at all — only unrelated education and Telegrafi pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: No fakulteti.mk URL surfaced in search; the site's business/economy coverage of bank-vendor deals could not be evidenced in this pass. Not recorded as dead — likely a search-index/ranking issue rather than an offline site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One of the named cell targets is unvalidated; if it does carry bank-tech coverage it is currently a blind spot.

negative_findings.description: A targeted MK query naming likely core vendors (Асеко/Asseco, Halcom, Printec) alongside 'потпиша договор' and 'платежни терминали' returned no MK press article naming a bank-vendor contract.
negative_findings.result_summary: Results were bank T&C PDFs and generic product pages; no MK-language media item explicitly naming a technology supplier contract was retrieved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests MK media rarely name the technology supplier in deal stories — vendor attribution will usually have to come from vendor press releases, procurement records or bank annual reports, with MK press used only for the timing signal.

negative_findings.description: The available web search is US-indexed and returns only first-page-style result sets; deep paging into MK portal archives was not possible from search alone.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recall for MK/AL long-tail portals is likely incomplete; several candidates were found only indirectly via aggregator and snowball links.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Source discovery for this cell should be re-run against on-site search endpoints and TIME.mk's outlet directory rather than relying on general web search.

negative_findings.description: No fetch/liveness checking was performed on any listed URL in this pass; all URLs come from search result listings.
negative_findings.result_summary: All candidates are unverified for reachability, robots.txt policy and paywall/consent-wall behaviour.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Access_status and collection feasibility fields are hypotheses that the deterministic verification pass must confirm.

coverage_gaps.description: The primary portal is bot-defended and its award data is not search-indexed, so no reliable read path has been proven yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a headless-browser probe against e-nabavki.gov.mk, record the XHR calls behind the notices/awarded-contracts grids, and document the resulting service endpoints and pagination as the canonical collection method.

coverage_gaps.description: The machine-readable ESJN concluded-contracts dataset on data.gov.mk has not been located, downloaded or schema-checked.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search data.gov.mk for 'склучени договори' / 'јавни набавки', resolve the redirect, download one file and record schema, row count, date range and whether the awarded economic operator and contract value are present.

coverage_gaps.description: No local-language keyword/CPV filter set exists for banking and payments IT subjects.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assemble and test a Macedonian + English term list (софтвер за банкарско работење, картичен систем, ПОС терминали, банкомати/АТМ, платежен систем, МИПС, персонализација на картички, ХСМ, дигитално банкарство, инстант плаќања) against the portal search and record recall per term.

coverage_gaps.description: Beyond NBRSM, the set of relevant contracting authorities for payments/banking IT (Управа за јавни приходи, Царинска управа, Фонд за ПИОМ, ЗФРМ, state-owned enterprises, municipalities operating payment services) has not been enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate institutions in the ESJN institution list and shortlist those with financial/payment operations; build a watchlist for per-institution monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: Unknown how far back the portal's public archive and any bulk dataset reach, and whether pre-2019 (old ZJN) records are retained.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the earliest retrievable notice date on the portal and in the open dataset; if the archive is truncated, evaluate the Ministry of Finance archive site (arhiva.finance.gov.mk) and civic-tech dumps as backfill.

coverage_gaps.description: Award notices name winners; the competitor set (losing bidders) is only partially visible, mainly via appeals decisions and evaluation reports.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Systematically crawl ДКЖЈН decisions and the evaluation/award-decision PDFs in ESJN dossiers to reconstruct bidder lists per tender.

coverage_gaps.description: Procurements below the mandatory e-publication threshold, and central-bank procurements potentially exempt or confidential, will not appear in the ESJN.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-check NBRSM's own procurement page and State Audit Office reports for contracts absent from the ESJN; flag confidentiality exemptions explicitly in the source model.

coverage_gaps.description: TED's own faceted search and bulk/open-data endpoints were not exercised, so the actual volume and CPV distribution of MK financial-infrastructure notices is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a scripted TED API query for country=MK across CPV 66100000, 48000000, 72200000, 30144200 and profile 2019-2026 award notices before committing collection resources.

coverage_gaps.description: ECEPP was not queried for the North Macedonia + financial institutions filter, so it is unknown how many live and historic MK financial-sector notices it holds or whether award notices are publicly readable without login.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Register a free supplier account and profile the MK notice history; determine whether contract award notices expose winning-bidder names publicly.

coverage_gaps.description: The National Bank of North Macedonia (Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија) appears as a donor counterpart (WBG electronic-payments assessment) but its own procurement/tender pages were not located in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search nbrm.mk / nbstat.nbrm.mk for јавни набавки and for donor-cofinanced projects; the central bank is the key MK counterpart for payment-infrastructure work.

coverage_gaps.description: Other IFIs plausibly active in MK financial infrastructure were not searched: CEB (Council of Europe Development Bank), IFC advisory, EFSE/Finance in Motion, GGF, and the EU's WB Guarantee/Growth Plan Reform and Growth Facility.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the next pass to IFC advisory disclosures, EFSE (already surfaced via EIB project 20120483), GGF and the Reform and Growth Facility for the Western Balkans, which is a large new 2024-2027 EU money stream into MK.

coverage_gaps.description: Macedonian-language coverage relied on Cyrillic terms only; Albanian-language and Latin-script Macedonian variants were not searched, and MK institutions increasingly publish Albanian versions.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Albanian queries (prokurimi publik, tender, Banka Botërore, BERZH) and Latin-script transliterations (javni nabavki, EBOR) to the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical baseline was established: it is unknown which international vendors have previously won donor-funded MK financial-infrastructure contracts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Bulk-pull the WB Finances One contract-award dataset and the OpenTender MK slice, normalise supplier names, and build a 2015-2026 vendor league table as the baseline for ongoing monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: Regional/multi-country lots (Western Balkans, EU4Digital) hide MK relevance inside eligibility text, so country-field filtering will miss them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build full-text matching on 'North Macedonia' across regional notice bodies on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal and WBIF, not just structured country filters.

coverage_gaps.description: MK job ads are ephemeral — banks and boards delete ads after the application deadline and there is no national archive of vacancy text.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Stand up a scheduled harvester (daily/weekly) that snapshots full ad bodies at publication for a fixed employer watchlist; retro-collection will not recover the corpus.

coverage_gaps.description: Career pages resolved for only a minority of MK banks (Stopanska, NLB, Komercijalna root) and vendors; the rest of the ~13-bank market plus vendors (Duna, Seavus, Semos, Sorsix, Netcetera, Edusoft) are unmapped for hiring signals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the full employer watchlist from the NBRSM list of licensed banks plus the MASIT member directory, then resolve and pin one careers URL per employer.

coverage_gaps.description: CV-side coverage is thin and legally constrained — LinkedIn is gated, and no MK-specific public CV repository was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test alternative public-CV surfaces (GitHub profiles, Toptal/Upwork/Arc resumes, conference speaker bios, MASIT/FINKI alumni pages) with employer+product keyword pairs; keep collection aggregate-only and record institution-platform facts, never personal dossiers.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language hiring channels were not searched, despite a substantial Albanian-speaking workforce and banks (e.g. TTK, Halkbank) recruiting in it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an sq-language query pass ('shpallje pune', 'punësim bankë', 'inxhinier softueri Shkup') even though the run scope names only mk/en, and record it as an out-of-scope enrichment.

coverage_gaps.description: No structured-data access path (API, RSS, JSON endpoint) was confirmed for any MK job board in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe each board for RSS/JSON (Workable exposes a JSON endpoint per account; check vrabotuvanje/pazar3/vraboti.se for feeds) and negotiate JobMatch.mk data access rather than scraping ToS-restricted HTML.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage is Skopje-centric; branch and regional IT/operations ads (Štip, Bitola, Tetovo, Strumica) were only incidentally observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Include regional city filters in board queries — branch-level operations ads sometimes name the teller/channel application more plainly than HQ ads.

coverage_gaps.description: Speaker, agenda and sponsor pages of the regional events (infintech.me/speakers, money-motion.eu sponsors, paybalkan sponsor page) were identified but not individually fetched and parsed for MK affiliations.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch each event's speakers/agenda/sponsors page per edition (including archived editions) and run an affiliation filter for MK banks, MK vendors and .mk domains.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language MK sources were out of the run's language scope (mk, en) despite a large Albanian-speaking MK business community and Tirana-hosted regional payments events.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an sq-language pass (konferencë bankare, sponsorë, fintech Maqedoni e Veriut) if the run scope can be widened.

coverage_gaps.description: Trade expos/fairs (e.g. Skopje Fair / Скопски саем technology or finance editions), university-hosted ICT conferences (ICT Innovations), and startup/venture events with fintech tracks were not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on Скопски саем, ICT Innovations, Startup Macedonia and Fund for Innovation (ФИТР) event calendars for fintech tracks and exhibitor lists.

coverage_gaps.description: No archived-editions strategy was established; most event sites overwrite sponsor walls each year, destroying the year-over-year signal this cell depends on.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot each identified event site annually (and back-fill via web.archive.org) so sponsor-tier changes can be diffed over time.

coverage_gaps.description: Only two vendor newsrooms (ASEE/Payten, Natech) were captured as examples of the vendor-side sponsorship-disclosure pattern.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a watchlist of regional/global core-banking, card and self-service vendors active in MK and poll their events/news pages on the same cadence.

coverage_gaps.description: The State Treasury (Трезор) within the Ministry of Finance and its payment/settlement operations were not separately located; no treasury-specific portal or document store was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted mk search on 'Трезор', 'трезорска сметка', 'Секторот за трезор' plus direct crawl of finance.gov.mk organisational pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Sub-national public buyers (municipalities, City of Skopje) and state-owned enterprises that procure POS/payment and fiscalisation technology were not covered in this cell pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use e-nabavki contracting-authority filters rather than individual municipal websites to cover this economically.

coverage_gaps.description: Audit and oversight bodies — Државен завод за ревизија (State Audit Office) and Државна комисија за жалби по јавни набавки (procurement appeals commission) — were not searched; both publish findings that reveal how state payment/IT contracts were awarded and contested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated mk searches for dzr.mk and the appeals commission; harvest audit reports mentioning УЈП, МФ and ИТ набавки.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) government publications were out of the declared run scope (mk, en) but a substantial share of official communication and business media in North Macedonia is bilingual.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If scope allows, add sq terms (fiskalizimi, faturimi elektronik, pagesa të menjëhershme) for a second pass.

coverage_gaps.description: EU accession instruments — IPA programming documents, the annual EC Country Report chapters on taxation and financial services, and the Secretariat for European Affairs (СЕП) — were not covered, though they fund and schedule much of the payments/digitalisation programme.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search sep.gov.mk and EC enlargement reports for taxation/financial-services digitalisation commitments and IPA-funded payment projects.

coverage_gaps.description: КЗК and ДКЖЈН decision corpora were reachable only at navigation level; individual decisions were not retrievable through search.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated crawler over the Cyrillic-path category pages and their /images/YYYY/ and /sites/default/files/ PDF directories, building a case-level index (case number, parties, date, sector).

coverage_gaps.description: Службен весник на РСМ (Official Gazette) was not scouted as a source in this pass, yet it is where licence withdrawals, sanctions and supervisory decisions become legally public.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout slvesnik.com.mk / the official gazette portal for a searchable archive and subscription/access terms; it is likely the authoritative fallback for the missing NBRSM sanctions register.

coverage_gaps.description: Administrative Court (Управен суд) and Misdemeanour court decisions on appeals against КЗК/НБРСМ/АЗЛП actions were not directly scouted (only the КЗК's own court-decisions page).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the judicial portal (sud.mk) and the court decisions database for a searchable corpus, and assess whether party names are anonymised.

coverage_gaps.description: North Macedonia is officially bilingual (mk/sq) and institutions such as ДЗР brand themselves as 'Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit', but the run's language scope is mk+en only, so Albanian-language enforcement/audit publications were not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If scope allows, add sq terms (Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit, Komisioni për Mbrojtjen e Konkurrencës, prokurim publik) to catch documents published only in Albanian.

coverage_gaps.description: Internal audit / public internal financial control (Централна единица за хармонизација, Министерство за финансии PFM monitoring) reports were only glimpsed via a Ministry of Finance PFM monitoring document and not scouted as a standing source.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout finance.gov.mk and arhiva.finance.gov.mk for the annual PIFC/PFM reports, which aggregate internal-audit findings including IT and procurement weaknesses.

coverage_gaps.description: e-nabavki.gov.mk is an ASP.NET application whose data sits behind .aspx grids and .asmx services; no confirmed bulk-export or open-data endpoint was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test whether the portal exposes an open-data/API export or whether headless-browser scraping is required, and check the portal terms of use for scraping constraints before scaling collection.

coverage_gaps.description: No company-registry source was captured (Central Registry of RNM) to resolve ownership, founding dates and shareholders of MK payment startups.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add crm.com.mk / the Central Registry business-entity search as a resolution source and test whether structured lookup is possible without a paid account.

coverage_gaps.description: App-store listings (Google Play / App Store MK) for wallets and payment apps were not enumerated; they carry release cadence, changelogs and SDK/partner hints.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an app-store watchlist for MK wallet and bank apps, tracking version notes and permissions/SDKs.

coverage_gaps.description: Individual remittance operator MK pages (Western Union, Ria, MoneyGram, Intel Express, Zolotaya Korona-type corridors) were not individually enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Systematically enumerate agent/partner pages per operator and cross-check against the NBRNM BTP provider list.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language sources were not searched, although Albanian is widely used in MK and some payment/remittance actors communicate in it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an Albanian-term pass (portofol digjital, pagesa online, transferta parash) even though the run scope lists only mk/en.

coverage_gaps.description: No developer/API documentation portal for MK gateways was directly captured (cPay technical docs, bank e-commerce developer pages).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and register the cPay merchant technical specification and each acquiring bank's e-commerce integration documentation as direct sources.

coverage_gaps.description: The archive lane (Wayback CDX enumeration of MK bank domains kb.com.mk, stb.com.mk, nlb.mk, halkbank.mk, sparkasse.mk, ttk.com.mk, uni.com.mk and vendor domains printec.com, see.asseco.com, nextsense.com, duna.mk, seavus.com) was defined but not executed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run CDX queries per domain from an unrestricted HTTP client, snapshot-diff 'references/customers/partners' and 'cards/e-banking' URL paths, and store recovered pages locally.

coverage_gaps.description: The richest structured aggregators for this cell (SeeNews full archive, EMIS company profiles, bne IntelliNews, AppsRunTheWorld customer database) are subscription-gated, so only headlines and teasers were observable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cost/benefit a single subscription (SeeNews likely highest yield for MK deal flow) and otherwise restrict collection to public leads plus primary-source corroboration.

coverage_gaps.description: Rating agencies and commercial market-research houses covering MK banking (Fitch/Moody's/S&P country and bank reports, RBI CEE Banking Sector Report, EY/PwC/Deloitte SEE banking studies) were not searched in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up query set for 'CEE Banking Sector Report North Macedonia', 'Fitch/Moody's rating action Komercijalna/Stopanska/NLB Banka' and Big Four SEE banking surveys.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was liveness-verified; several are recorded from search-result listings only, and blocked flags are inferences from listing behaviour rather than confirmed HTTP responses.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic verification pass over all example_urls and downgrade or correct blocked/blocker_type fields from real status codes.

coverage_gaps.description: Macedonian-language coverage in this cell is thin by nature: regional/international aggregators publish about MK in English, and only the EC report translation portal supplied substantive MK-language material.

NLB Banka Skopje, Sparkasse Bank Makedonija, ProCredit, Silk Road Bank, TTK Banka, Centralna Kooperativna Banka, UNIBanka, Capital Bank and the Development Bank of North Macedonia are entirely uncovered on the vendor-reference axis.
